build.fixtureEngineNote: Older retained fixture engine; original-game replays use the frozen Superfrog-qualified engine recorded in each run. Distinct coverage.

nativeReferenceConfiguration.note: The early native 3.1 FFP probe invokes the native ROM FindResident/InitResident path before OpenLibrary.

knownLimits: Game completion, multiplayer, saves and original disks 2/3 are not qualified.
console.device window units, complete Alt/dead-key composition and preferences are unqualified.
General conflicting shared/exclusive lock arbitration is unqualified.
keyboard.device asynchronous ReadEvent, repeat/reset handlers and reset-chord behavior are unqualified.
These correctness replays do not establish throughput acceptance or audio fidelity.
The full CopperStart solution cannot restore SDK g20; the standalone ROM and affected components build separately.
A thin vertical blue graphics artifact occurs in both CopperStart and the native Kickstart 3.1 control; it remains unresolved.

preCacheDiagnostic.note: Entered 485 for visible Table E/05/Q after a booklet misread; correct code is 495. The game correctly issued a new challenge. Table B/12/G code 440 was then accepted. TW5 progressed from 3352 to 7968 bytes between fields 75000 and 85000, motivating the guest sector cache. This is not the final-ROM replay.

sectorCache.storage: Existing public guest RAM, optional allocation with uncached fallback

trainingAllocationBefore.note: Training entered the Blitz out-of-memory cleanup/TRAP path after AllocMem returned zero; subsequent CIA-B/exception corruption was a consequence. This intermediate ROM is not the final gameplay qualification.

publicHunkIntermediate.note: Native public hunks alone still entered out-of-memory cleanup at Training. This is diagnostic evidence, not final qualification.

idleMemoryIntermediate.note: Reached Team Inquiry at field 104000. Did not attempt Training: the captured free Chip block was already too small. The parked parser and decoded-track cache were then retired.

idleCacheIntermediate.note: Reached the main menu at field 106000. Training was not attempted because the contiguous Chip block was too small. The permanent DOS vector storage was then compacted.

sharedDosVectors.note: Focused tests include six synthetic ABI cases and six native HUNK/lifetime cases; counts overlap the full suite.

compactDosIntermediate.note: Reached the main menu at field 100000. Training was not attempted because the contiguous Chip block was too small. The early ROM-font table allocation was then eliminated.

romFontLocations.note: Native references establish ROM placement and TypeOfMem zero. Replacement metrics and table data are unchanged; native glyph extents are not assumed to equal their advance.

testInspectionCorrection.note: Two RAM-only test inspection reads could not inspect the new ROM font pointer. The test reader was corrected; production ROM bytes did not change.

fontOnlyIntermediate.note: The immutable font table saved Slow RAM but did not change Chip residency. Training was not attempted. Boot service processes were still forced into Chip RAM.

bootServiceStorage.note: Filesystem, console and startup Process owners/stacks use the ordinary public-memory preference. Actual fitted A501 memory is preferred; the bounded machine and caller flags are unchanged.

bookletInput.source: Visual lookup in the supplied published Code Booklet PDF; only the visible prompt caption was inspected in guest RAM.
